intro: LLM ek next-token predictor hai; product banana uske around context, retrieval aur guardrails ka kaam hai. Is section me token budget, prompt templates, chunking, retrieval scoring, top-k context assembly aur JSON output parsing practice hote hain.
theory: Model ek context window me hi sab kuch dekhta hai. Token budget prompt + retrieved context + output ke beech baantna padta hai.
Prompt template instructions, context aur question ko clear sections me rakhta hai; delimiter/format se model ko boundary pata chalti hai.
Chunking document ko chhote overlapping pieces me todti hai. Chunk size retrieval precision aur context completeness ke beech trade-off hai.
RAG me retrieval pehle hota hai, phir model retrieved text ke saath answer banata hai. Retrieval galat ho to LLM confidently galat bol sakta hai.
Structured output ke liye JSON schema do, response parse karo, aur parse fail par retry/fallback rakho — free-form text ko directly trust mat karo.

examples.code:
import math
from collections import Counter

DOCS = {
    'refund-policy': 'Refunds take five business days after approval.',
    'shipping-faq': 'Shipping takes two days for metro cities.',
    'contact': 'Support is available from 9 am to 6 pm.',
}
question = 'How long do refunds take?'
q = Counter(question.lower().replace('?', '').split())

def score(text):
    t = Counter(text.lower().replace('.', '').split())
    dot = sum(q[k] * t[k] for k in q)
    return dot / (math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in q.values())) * math.sqrt(sum(v * v for v in t.values()))) if dot else 0.0

ranked = sorted(((name, score(text)) for name, text in DOCS.items()), key=lambda item: -item[1])
top = [name for name, value in ranked if value > 0][:1]
context = '\n'.join(f'[{name}] {DOCS[name]}' for name in top)
print('sources:', top)
print('context:', context)
print('answer:', DOCS[top[0]] if top else 'No source found')
explain: Retrieval, top-k context aur grounded answer — RAG ka poora chhota loop.
Ye snippet end-to-end flow dikhata hai.
Output ko project/interview me evidence ki tarah use karo.

realWorld: Enterprise RAG assistants me permission-aware retrieval zaroori hai: user ko sirf wahi documents milne chahiye jinke wo allowed hain.
Token budget cross na kare, isliye context chunks ko rank karke top-k hi bheja jata hai aur output ke liye tokens reserve rehte hain.
LLM output ko downstream service me bhejne se pehle schema validate karna production safety ka basic step hai.

interview.q: RAG plain fine-tuning se kab better hai?
interview.a: Jab knowledge frequently badalta ho ya citations chahiye. RAG retrieval se fresh private data use kar sakta hai; fine-tuning style/format sikhata hai par naya data roz nahi sikha sakta.

interview.q: Chunk size kaise choose karte hain?
interview.a: Chunk chhota ho to retrieval precise par context adhoora; bada ho to context poora par noise zyada. Content structure ke hisaab se section-level chunks + overlap aksar best hote hain.

interview.q: Hallucination kam karne ke practical steps kya hain?
interview.a: Sirf retrieved context se answer karne ka instruction, citations, low temperature, retrieval quality metrics, aur answer ke baad grounding check.

interview.q: LLM output ko JSON kyun parse karte hain?
interview.a: Downstream service ko typed fields chahiye. JSON schema se validate karte hain aur parse fail par retry/fallback — free text ko programmatically use karna fragile hai.

debugging.why: int() sirf poore number ka string parse karta hai. Ye Generative AI, LLMs & RAG ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: Pehle float() phir int() karo, ya Decimal use karo.
debugging.lesson: ValueError format ka issue hai, type ka nahi.

debugging.why: String immutable hai; append list ka method hai. Ye Generative AI, LLMs & RAG ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: String concatenation ya join use karo.
debugging.lesson: AttributeError galat type par method call ka signal hai.

debugging.why: Naam ki spelling galat hai; Python namespace me wo naam nahi milta. Ye Generative AI, LLMs & RAG ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.lesson: NameError typo ya missing assignment batata hai.

debugging.error: Logic error — sort() None return karta hai, list print nahi hoti
debugging.why: sort() in-place hai aur None deta hai, isliye print None dikhata hai. Ye Generative AI, LLMs & RAG ke workflow me bhi wahi galti hai.
debugging.fix: sorted() use karo ya pehle sort phir list print karo.
debugging.lesson: Mutating methods ka return value None hota hai — usse assign/print mat karo.
